name: Verify Numerical Reasoning
description: Measures ability to work with numerical data and make logical inferences from numbers, tables, and graphs. Suitable for roles requiring numerical analysis and data interpretation.

name: Verify Verbal Reasoning
description: Assesses ability to understand and evaluate written information, draw logical conclusions from text, and reason with verbal concepts. Ideal for roles requiring communication and analysis.

name: Verify Inductive Reasoning
description: Measures ability to identify patterns and relationships in abstract information. Assesses logical thinking and the capacity to solve problems with unfamiliar information.

name: Verify Interactive – Numerical Reasoning
description: An adaptive, interactive assessment of numerical reasoning. Adapts question difficulty based on responses for a precise measure of numerical ability.

name: Verify Interactive – Verbal Reasoning
description: An adaptive, interactive assessment of verbal reasoning. Measures the ability to work with written information in a dynamic, adaptive format.

name: OPQ32r
description: The Occupational Personality Questionnaire is a well-established measure of personality at work. Assesses 32 dimensions of personality relevant to workplace performance and behavior.

name: MQ: Motivation Questionnaire
description: Assesses what motivates and energizes candidates at work. Covers 18 motivation factors to understand what drives employee engagement and performance.

name: Java 8 (New)
description: Tests knowledge and application of Java 8 programming concepts including lambdas, streams, functional interfaces, and modern Java features.

name: Core Java (Advanced Level)
description: Evaluates advanced Java programming skills including multithreading, design patterns, JVM internals, and enterprise Java development.

name: Automata - Fix (Programming Simulations)
description: A coding simulation where candidates debug and fix code in a realistic IDE environment. Assesses practical coding ability and debugging skills.

name: Python (New)
description: Assesses Python programming knowledge including data structures, OOP, standard libraries, and Pythonic code practices.

name: JavaScript (New)
description: Evaluates JavaScript programming skills including ES6+, DOM manipulation, asynchronous programming, and modern JavaScript frameworks.

name: SQL (New)
description: Tests knowledge of SQL database querying, data manipulation, joins, aggregations, and database design concepts.

name: Agile Software Development
description: Assesses knowledge of agile methodologies including Scrum, Kanban, sprint planning, and agile project management principles.

name: Graduate 8.0 (Short Verify)
description: A shorter version of Verify assessments designed for graduate-level candidates. Covers numerical, verbal, and inductive reasoning.

name: Situational Judgement Test (SJT) - Customer Service
description: Presents realistic customer service scenarios and evaluates how candidates would respond. Measures judgment, empathy, and problem-solving in customer-facing situations.

name: Sales Potential Questionnaire
description: Measures personality traits and behavioral tendencies associated with sales success. Identifies candidates with the drive, resilience, and interpersonal skills for sales roles.

name: Call Center Customer Service
description: Assesses skills required for customer service call center roles including communication, problem resolution, and handling difficult customers.

name: Financial Professional – Short Form
description: Assesses knowledge and skills for financial roles including accounting concepts, financial analysis, and regulatory knowledge.

name: General Ability - Short Form
description: A brief measure of general cognitive ability covering numerical, verbal, and abstract reasoning. Suitable for high-volume selection.

name: Workplace English Language Assessment
description: Assesses English language proficiency for workplace contexts including reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills.

name: ServiceFirst
description: A personality and motivational assessment specifically designed to identify candidates with the temperament and drive to excel in service-oriented roles.

name: Retail – Short Form
description: Assesses numerical, verbal, and checking skills specifically relevant to retail environments. Suitable for volume retail hiring.

name: Mechanical Comprehension
description: Measures understanding of mechanical and physical principles such as force, levers, gears, and pulleys. Used for engineering, technical, and operations roles.

name: Occupational Personality Questionnaire – Manager
description: A targeted personality questionnaire for managerial roles, assessing leadership, decision-making, and people management dimensions.

name: Data Entry Speed and Accuracy
description: Measures typing speed and accuracy for data entry roles. Candidates enter alphanumeric data in realistic formats.

name: Technology Professional 8.0
description: Assesses cognitive skills important for technology and IT professional roles, including logical thinking, numerical reasoning, and problem solving.

name: DevOps (New)
description: Assesses knowledge of DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, containerization, infrastructure as code, and monitoring.

name: Cloud Computing (New)
description: Tests knowledge of cloud platforms, architectures, and services including AWS, Azure, and GCP concepts.

name: Machine Learning (New)
description: Assesses theoretical and practical knowledge of machine learning concepts, algorithms, model evaluation, and data preprocessing.

name: Verify G+ (Cognitive Ability)
description: A comprehensive cognitive ability assessment covering numerical, verbal, and inductive reasoning in a single adaptive test.

name: Smart Interview Live
description: A structured digital interview platform enabling standardized behavioral and competency-based interviews with automated scoring.

name: Smart Interview On Demand
description: An asynchronous video interview solution where candidates record answers to structured questions. AI-assisted scoring for efficiency.

name: Microsoft Excel (New)
description: Tests practical Excel skills including formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, and spreadsheet management for business roles.

name: Project Management Professional
description: Assesses knowledge of project management principles, methodologies (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile), risk management, and stakeholder communication.

name: Strategic Thinking
description: Evaluates the capacity for long-term strategic analysis, business planning, and decision-making in complex environments.

name: Global Skills Assessment (GSA)
description: A short, adaptive cognitive assessment measuring general mental ability across verbal, numerical, and abstract dimensions. Designed for global use with minimal cultural bias.

name: C# (New)
description: Assesses C# programming knowledge including .NET framework, OOP principles, LINQ, async programming, and modern C# features.

name: Leadership Assessment
description: Comprehensive assessment of leadership potential and competencies including vision, influence, execution, and people development.

name: Checking
description: Measures attention to detail and accuracy in checking written and numerical information. Essential for administrative, clerical, and data-intensive roles.

name: Scales General Population (GPI)
description: A general population norm-referenced personality instrument measuring core personality factors relevant to workplace behavior.

name: SEI: Sales Effectiveness Inventory
description: Assesses the core competencies and behavioral traits that predict success in sales roles including persistence, competitive drive, and customer focus.

name: Dependability and Safety Instrument (DSI)
description: Assesses personality traits associated with dependability, safety compliance, integrity, and reliability in operational and frontline roles.

name: Administrative Professional – Short Form
description: Designed for administrative and clerical roles, assessing verbal, numerical, and checking skills essential for office environments.

name: Entrepreneurial Potential Questionnaire
description: Measures behavioral tendencies and personality characteristics associated with entrepreneurial success, including risk tolerance, innovation, and drive.
